en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.139 - Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
'I feel wind in my stomach to the extent that I think it has exited.'
Imam (as) said: 'You do not need to perform ablution unless you hear a sound or perceive the smell.'

Imam (as) then added:
'Indeed, Satan sits between a man's buttocks and causes him to think he has passed wind to make him doubt.'.
